body_markdown:
The marriage of the stator and rotor within an[electric motor (eMotor)](https://atsindustrialautomation.com/where-we-play/emobility/emotor-assembly-testing/) is a critical step in assembly that demands precision and careful handling. When these components are not properly integrated, several challenges and product problems can arise.
